timeline.text: I used to dictate a blog post into Telegram and it published itself, right away.
The writer was guessing — inventing details, or forgetting things I'd said another day.
Now it reads my own notes and my project list first, before it writes a word.
If something's missing, it asks — and saves a draft instead of publishing it.
I get Publish, Edit or Cancel, and now three ways of writing a post all go through that same check.
